'''''Ranunculus penicillatus''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] belonging to the family [[Ranunculaceae]].<ref name="POWO">{{cite web |title=Ranunculus penicillatus (Dumort.) Bab. {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:713480-1 |website=Plants of the World Online |access-date=15 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

Its native range is Europe and Morocco.<ref name="POWO" />

Synonyms:
* '' Batrachium penicillatum'' Dumort.<ref name="POWO" />
* ''Ranunculus cambricus'' A.Benn. ex Druce<ref name="POWO" />
